gzipPolicy: Fully decoded and scanned first; deterministic compression after path substitution. Decoded inverse is byte exact; original compressed container bytes are not reproduced.
approvalPolicy: Original review hashes bind original jobs only. Rebased files and changed dependency hashes require fresh review. No approval or runtime admission is inherited.
dependencyPolicy: Only listed files are included. Referenced native PNG and legacy host dependencies must be restored separately using their immutable public source manifests. No dependency is guessed.
sourceSHAAndCalibrationPolicy: Native source SHA, scalar measurements, coordinates and combat profiles are unchanged. Only four documented path prefixes are substituted.
